summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Pietro Frugoni, an Italian general of the Kingdom of Italy. It gives his birth and death dates and places, both in Brescia, and notes that he took an active part in World War I, especially in the first four Battles of the Isonzo.
one_line: Pietro Frugoni was an Italian general of the Kingdom of Italy who fought in the first four Battles of the Isonzo in World War I.
key_facts: Pietro Frugoni was born in Brescia on 21 January 1851.
Pietro Frugoni died in Brescia on 10 July 1940.
Pietro Frugoni was an Italian General of the Kingdom of Italy.
Pietro Frugoni actively participated in World War I.
Pietro Frugoni took an active part especially in the first four Battles of the Isonzo.
